command:
set -e
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' '--- OS/KERNEL ---'
cat /etc/redhat-release
uname -r
printf '%s\n' '--- BOOT ID ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '%s\n' '--- ACCOUNT ---'
if id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then id appworker; getent passwd appworker; else printf '%s\n' 'appworker: absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- LIMIT CONFIG ---'
grep -n '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]' /etc/security/limits.conf 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -d /etc/security/limits.d ]; then ls -ld /etc/security/limits.d; grep -R -n '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]' /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- PAM LIMITS ---'
grep -n 'pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d/login /etc/pam.d/sshd /etc/pam.d/system-auth 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- SSH SERVICE ---'
if command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then service sshd status 2>&1 || true; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- ROOT FS DATA ---'
df -P /
